name: Honto no Kimochi
source:
Hoping to get a girlfriend, college sophomore Toya applied for a part-time job at the Royal Cast family restaurant which was known for its pretty waitresses.
On his way to the restaurant his first day he crossed paths with a young girl and got in a quarrel. That was how he met Akari.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE146609.html]DLsite English[/url]]
